metadata.title: Mobile Threat Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for detecting and signaling active threats affecting mobile devices, applications, and data exposure.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile threat detection, behavioral analysis, network monitoring, and runtime threat intelligence for mobile platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern for continuous threat detection and risk signal generation without granting execution or administrative trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Threat Protection aligns with NIST guidance on threat detection, continuous monitoring, and Zero Trust architectures.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Threat Protection defines the capabilities required to detect malicious behavior affecting mobile devices and applications. This pattern produces threat signals only and does not include remediation, containment, or lifecycle actions.

components.title: Malicious Mobile Application Detection
components.description: Detects malicious, trojanized, or high‑risk mobile applications that threaten institutional data or services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Malicious mobile application distributed through unofficial channels.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Mobile application abusing permissions to exfiltrate data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Behavioral analysis and app reputation detect malicious applications.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Malicious code is detected on mobile devices and applications.
Mobile application vulnerabilities and threats are assessed.

components.title: Mobile Platform Compromise Detection
components.description: Detects indicators of mobile operating system compromise, rooting, or bypass of platform security controls.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Impairment of mobile OS security defenses.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Runtime integrity monitoring detects platform compromise.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Unauthorized mobile platform changes are detected.

components.title: Mobile Network‑Based Threat Detection
components.description: Detects malicious or high‑risk network activity affecting mobile devices and applications.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Network‑based interception or manipulation of mobile traffic.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Network traffic analysis detects adversary‑in‑the‑middle attacks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protections monitor mobile network activity.
Mobile communications are monitored for malicious activity.

components.title: Mobile Threat Signal Generation
components.description: Generates structured threat signals to inform posture evaluation and risk‑based access decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or manipulation of threat telemetry to evade detection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Threat telemetry reporting enables informed Zero Trust decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Threat signals are incorporated into access decisions.
Threat events are generated and reported.
